actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in qemu in the background so that telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches the guest login prompt, and block until it is ready.
required_behaviors: QEMU must be started in the background and remain running
Connecting with telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 must present the guest login prompt
The agent should stop after readiness is established and not log in
known_invalid_patterns: Only verifying the ISO file exists
Only starting qemu without confirming telnet readiness
Only checking that a port is open without reaching the login prompt
Logging into the guest instead of stopping at the prompt
verification_plan: Launch qemu with host port 6665 forwarded to the guest console/service as needed
Wait until the service is reachable
Verify by connecting to 127.0.0.1 6665 and observing the login prompt
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the qemu launch command
Receipt-backed evidence that telnet to 127.0.0.1 6665 shows the login prompt
